nodes.label: Epoch 4.0
nodes.rationale: Premier GitHub Community Club event designed for tech enthusiasts, developers, and innovators. Aims to inspire creative expression and build a strong tech community at GITAM University.

nodes.label: Epoch Coins System
nodes.rationale: Unified digital reward and activity currency designed to enhance student engagement. Encourages exploration of the entire fest, incentivizes learning-based participation, ensures fair resource usage, and provides a gamified experience.

nodes.label: Epoch Coins
nodes.source_location: section What Are Epoch Coins?, line 51
nodes.rationale: Official virtual currency of Epoch 4.0 acting as participation credits redeemable at Game Zones, VR Booths, and Fun & Activity Zones.

nodes.label: GeeksforGeeks Contest
nodes.rationale: Enhance problem-solving, logical thinking, and programming skills in a competitive environment. Provides a platform to test skills and gain exposure to competitive programming.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions Workshop
nodes.rationale: Help students gain a clear understanding of GitHub and its importance in a developer workflow, with focus on GitHub Actions and automation of tasks like testing and deployment.

nodes.label: Tech Workshop: DSA
nodes.rationale: Help students understand the importance of Data Structures and Algorithms in technical interviews and build strong problem-solving skills.

nodes.label: Gaming Tournament
nodes.rationale: Bring students together through competitive digital gameplay, fostering teamwork, quick thinking, and strategic skills.

nodes.label: Prompt to Prototype
nodes.rationale: Introduce students to prompt-based development and rapid prototyping using modern AI tools, transforming simple text prompts into working prototypes.

nodes.label: Flashmob
nodes.rationale: Banner launch and pre-event activation to generate awareness for Epoch 4.0.

nodes.label: Recharge Stations
nodes.rationale: Special recharge counters placed across the venue where students earn additional coins by playing selected mini-games or completing quick challenges.
